title: Headhunter email watcher: Naver IMAP auto-draft + notify
desc: Naver IMAP poller that detects headhunter emails, auto-drafts Korean reply using resume data, notifies via wkappbot pending_prompts, sends via SMTP after user approval.
steps: Setup: python resume/scripts/headhunter_mail.py setup -- creates hh_config.json template
Check inbox: python resume/scripts/headhunter_mail.py check -- scans UNSEEN, drafts, notifies
Notify: .wkappbot/pending_prompts/prompt_NOW_{guid}.json -- Eye delivers to Claude session
Drafts: hh_drafts/draft_{uid}.json -- status: pending to sent
App password: naver mail settings POP3/IMAP page
Credentials: load from D:\GitHub\.env (NAVER_ID=kiexpert, NAVER_APP_PASSWORD=4VRQKGRRJD3L). hh_config.json is gitignored.
MANDATORY -- Mail scan log: every Naver IMAP read MUST save ALL messages to resume/drafts/YYYYMMDD_naver_inbox_scan.md (full From+Subject table) and commit immediately. No exceptions.

Business partner follow-up emails (lisart/investor type): prepare 4-doc package (patent summary, tech doc, govt grants list, venture cert checklist) -> fix any missing fields in docs -> create email draft in resume/drafts/YYYYMMDD_<partner>_reply_email.md -> commit -> send via Naver mail (kiexpert@naver.com)
MANDATORY before send: 1) Opus review (tone/accuracy) 2) Codex proofread (typos/facts) 3) show results to user 4) wait for explicit user approval. NEVER auto-send without approval.
Cross-reference: wkappbot skill read willkim-schedule for job application deadlines and NVIDIA/Smilegate interview timeline

STANDARD ATTACHMENTS for all job applications: (1) resume/references/WkBitwiseSortSet-v18.pdf (2) resume/references/kimgiil_Portfolio_Algorithms_Optimization.PDF (3) resume/references/WillKim_Career_Description_bitwise.txt. Source: kiexpert/bitwise-sets GitHub docs/. Local copies committed in personal-docs. Run mail-send-review-gate BEFORE sending.
